Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to hear more about Acme Health's pilot goals and the production readiness criteria. As discussed, I wanted to summarize next steps and a few procurement/packaging questions so we can line up the right path for purchasing and avoid back-and-forth with your procurement team.

Summary of the call:
- Pilot scope: 3 teams, ~50k inference tokens/day during pilot, expected burst to 200k for demos.
- Security needs: SOC 2, VPC/networking for PHI workload (you flagged on the call).
- Success criteria: sub-200ms median latency for text-gen on hosted or dedicated; logging/audit capabilities.

Procurement/commercial questions (please confirm):
1) Payment method: Will procurement use purchase order (PO) / net terms or a corporate card for initial pilot? If PO, any specific PO workflow / finance contacts we should loop in?
2) Marketplace preference: Would you rather transact via Azure Marketplace/AWS Marketplace (vendor-managed billing) or direct Redwood contract & invoicing?
3) Deployment preference: For pilot, do you want Hosted (fastest to start) or Dedicated (reserved GPUs / isolation)? We can also do Private (VPC) but that adds setup time.
4) Commitment vs on-demand: Are you open to a short-term commit (3-month reserved capacity) for better unit pricing, or prefer on-demand billing for pilot?

Attached is an updated pricing proposal that maps hosted/dedicated/private options and sample commitment tiers (Redwood_PRICING_PROPOSAL_v3.pdf). I copied Aditya in case you want a technical follow-up on the Dedicated config or the Private deployment checklist.

Suggested next steps:
- You: Confirm procurement preference (PO vs card) and marketplace interest.
- We'll: Prep a one-pager SOW and a pricing worksheet tailored to your deployment choice (attached SOW_draft.docx).
- Optional: 30-minute procurement + legal sync the week of Sep 1 if you want to accelerate.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,

Thanks for the loop. Quick answers:
- Hosted VPC & KMS: Yes — Hosted supports customer-managed KMS keys for encryption at rest and we can deploy per-tenant VPC peering for isolating network traffic. For PHI workloads we'll recommend a short security onboarding (1-2 weeks) to configure network and keys.
- Azure Marketplace: We support transacting through Azure Marketplace for hosted deployments. Note: Marketplace billing can impose standard MSFT terms — subtle term/metering differences vs direct contract. For PO/Net-30 via marketplace, procurement sometimes still requires a separate master purchase agreement. We can work with our partnerships team to surface the right flow.
- Dedicated lead time & commits: Typical lead time is ~2-3 weeks to provision a dedicated pool. For proposal examples: 3-month commit (baseline capacity with +/- burst), 6-month commit for better unit discounts. I'll attach a short config sheet and an example commit pricing grid.

Attaching: Dedicated_config_sheet.pdf, Commit_pricing_grid.xlsx
